visualCharacteristics.structure: Select Decade dropdown + progress rail with one dot per card + scrolling row of milestone cards (image, year heading, bullet list) + prev/next edge controls
visualCharacteristics.purpose: company history timeline browsable by decade

contentPattern.structure: one row per milestone: picture | year heading (h3) + bullet list of events. Decades are not authored: the block groups rows by year to build the Select Decade dropdown (jump to the decade's first milestone) and draws the rail. 3 cards per view from 768px, 1 on mobile.
